conf.description: Forescout CEF Plugin host-property push alternate (host-property, syslog-cef): same label-indirection CEF decoder as the NAC/policy CEF forms, routed to the host inventory dataset.

conf.comment: host-property/syslog-cef: Send Customized CEF Message carrying host-property tags instead of event/compliance content, over the same SIEM server definition as policy-cef. Reuses the nac-event CEF decoder shape: fixed dictionary keys (dst/dmac/dhost/dvc/dvchost/rt) extracted by name; cs1..cs6 / cs1Label..cs6Label are per-policy bindings with no stable slot meaning here either, so the raw extension string is kept as one custom audit field rather than a guessed per-slot mapping (README gap, same as nac-event/syslog-cef).

functions.description: why this reuses the NAC CEF slot-blob approach for inventory content
Split the 8 pipe-delimited CEF header segments
Extract CEF extension key dst (endpoint IP)
Extract CEF extension key dmac (endpoint MAC)
Extract CEF extension key dhost (endpoint host name)
Extract CEF extension key dvc (CounterACT device IP)
Extract CEF extension key dvchost (CounterACT device host name)
Extract CEF extension key rt (report time, epoch ms)
batch every status:mapped field that needed no further transform
dmac normalization, rt conversion, raw cs*/label audit blob, event.dataset, cleanup
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
